Birth-cloud dust is back on by default. I changed `"birth_cloud_dust"` back to `True` in `notebooks/ceridwen_integrated_photometry_spectra.ipynb` and committed it as `2318348` on `absorption-mask`. The push failed because this sandbox blocks github.com, so run `git push` yourself. The wiki already said "On" (`wiki/notes/model.md`), so it needed no changes.

The tests for this area fail with or without the change, and none of the failures involve birth-cloud dust. They come from Ceridwen's `SSPDataAfe` now needing an `ssp_afe` argument, small numerical mismatches in the dust-bump tests, and a changed list of environment variables. Separately, the `ceridwen` submodule has a modified fixture, `ssp_data_bpass_agb_dust.h5`, which I didn't touch and left out of the commit.
